properties.description: Established in 1888, this landmark delicatessen has become a defining institution for traditional, hand-carved meats and Jewish-style comfort food in New York City. The brand is globally recognized for its signature pastrami and corned beef, served in an authentic, high-energy environment that has remained largely unchanged for generations. In addition to its bustling brick-and-mortar location on the Lower East Side, it maintains a significant national presence through a specialized shipping program that delivers its classic products to customers across the country. It occupies a unique space in the food market, sitting at the intersection of historical landmark and high-demand consumer destination.
properties.short_description: Katz's Delicatessen is New York City's oldest deli, famous for its pastrami and corned beef sandwiches, offering dine-in, catering, and delivery services.
